purpose: Grade the exact minimum number of active S-boxes over any four consecutive E256-H rounds when the H4 row-offset selector changes per round, which the E256-X0 receipt recorded as mixed_four_round_bound = OPEN_NOT_GRADED.

wide_receipt.supplies: 69 nonzero MixColumns minors, branch number 5, and the fixed-selector E256-W-WIDETRAIL-25-v1 four-round value of 25

x0_receipt.supplies: the safe-transition criterion S(y)+S(z)=Z_8 and the OPEN_NOT_GRADED item this gate closes

wide_runner.supplies: the frozen row_shift forward convention and the AES MDS matrix this gate reuses

activity_model.mix_columns: AES 4x4 circulant MDS over GF(2^8)/0x11b applied per column
activity_model.cost: sum of the four S-box layer activity weights
activity_model.bound_direction: every actual differential trail projects to a feasible activity pattern, so the relaxation minimum is a lower bound on the active S-box count
relaxation_is_not: a claim that a minimising pattern is realisable by actual differences

symmetry_quotient.per_round_translation: SR_{w+t} = Rot_t . SR_w with Rot_t commuting with MixColumns and ShiftRows
symmetry_quotient.global_row_rotation: R_rho . SR_w = SR_{R_rho w} . R_rho with R_rho commuting with the circulant MDS matrix
symmetry_quotient.canonical_rule: lexicographic minimum over rho in Z_4 of rotating all three tuples by rho then translating each tuple independently to first offset 0

smt.role: authoritative lower bound; unsat at budget B proves minimum > B
smt.encoding_note: shared integer column weights; no reified column-active indicator and no derived lemmas, which were measured to be far slower

ilp.role: independent exact minimum and optimal witness
ilp.encoding: all-binary variables with a <= 4d, b <= 4d, a + b >= branch*d per column

exhaustive.role: third independent minimum on the anchor and control cases
exhaustive.sound_pruning: cost >= 5*(k_1 + k_3), obtained by summing the per-column MDS constraints at the first and third boundaries

witness_checker.role: verify every solver witness against the MDS constraints and its claimed weight
witness_checker.must_reject: a witness with any single active byte removed

oracles.agreement_rule: disagreement between any two oracles on a shared case is a validity failure that forbids receipt emission

prior_disclosure.nature: X1 is a complete verification of facts already observed in a read-only pre-freeze exploration, not a blind prediction. Every item below must be reconstructed exactly.
items: the 16 catalog supports are exactly the sixteen 4-subsets S of Z_8 with S+S = Z_8, out of 70
the catalog is closed under translation and under cyclic row rotation, with free orbits giving 48 translation classes and 12 translation-plus-rotation classes per single tuple
the canonical triple-class count is 27648 = 384^3 / 2048, so the group action is free on ordered catalog triples
the exact minimum for the fixed tuple (0,1,3,4) repeated is 25, agreeing with E256-W-WIDETRAIL-25-v1
the exact minimum for the X0 fallback alternation (0,1,2,5)/(0,1,4,7)/(0,1,2,5) is 25
all 384 fixed-repeated catalog triples have exact minimum 25
a 3000-class random canonical sample had exact minimum 25 in every class, for both the X0-safe subfamily and its complement
control minima observed: zero row offsets 10, branch number forced to 4 gives 4, single-parity (0,2,4,6) repeated gives 25, sampled non-certified distinct tuples gave 25
a greedy (1,4,...) witness constructor does not reach 25, returning 40 or 45, so witnesses must come from a solver and be independently checked

predictions.statement: the recomputed catalog digest equals the frozen canonical_sha256 and the catalog order, first, fixed, and last tuples match
the 16 recomputed support masks are exactly the 4-subsets of Z_8 satisfying S+S = Z_8
the recomputed canonical class count equals 27648 with every orbit of size 2048
sampled orbit members share an identical exact minimum, confirming both symmetries empirically
the SMT, ILP, and exhaustive oracles agree exactly on the anchor and on every control case where all three are run
every solver witness is independently verified at its claimed weight, and the byte-removal tamper of each verified witness is rejected
the fixed Rijndael tuple repeated yields exact minimum 25, reproducing the inherited fixed-selector value
all 384 fixed-repeated triples yield exact minimum 25
the exact minimum over every canonical class is recorded as a histogram, and the global minimum over the complete family is reported
the minima over the X0-safe subfamily and over its non-safe complement are reported separately and compared
all 23 planted controls are detected through production loaders, oracles, the canonical quotient, or the witness checker

receipt_contract.check_rule: --check must regenerate byte-identical deterministic payload bytes and digest
